description: Time the CAN frame was logged; sequential, 1 reading per second.
CAN transmitter node that sent the frame: 0x101 engine, 0x102 transmission, 0x103 chassis.
Temperature in degrees Celsius (engine/coolant proxy). Normal about 85-95; above 105 is overheating.
Vibration magnitude in g. Idle about 0.1, driving about 0.2-0.45; above 0.8 is abnormal.
Engine speed in revolutions per minute. Idle about 800; cruising at 60-100 km/h about 2000-3200.
0 = no fault, 101 = overheating, 102 = abnormal vibration, 103 = overheating and abnormal vibration.
1 when fault_code is not 0, else 0. Target label for anomaly or fault detection.
